title: Martha Bakes
description:
S8 E10 — Naturally Gluten-Free
Italian-inspired cornmeal cake; spiced pumpkin pie with a crisp rice crust; flourless chocolate-walnut torte.

title: Martha Gardens
description:
S1 E8 — Martha Builds a Raised Bed Vegetable Garden
Martha builds a brand new, half-acre raised bed vegetable garden on her farm! It's a step-by-step guide to designing, building, preparing the soil, and planting.

title: Martha Gardens
description:
S1 E9 — Everything's Coming Up Roses
Everything is coming up roses on Martha's Bedford farm; Martha is creating a brand-new rose garden with almost 200 roses; from color to fragrance, the inspired world of roses is a very good thing.

title: Martha Gardens
description:
S1 E10 — Azaleas, Hostas, and Wild Birds
Martha's azalea grove is bursting with the last flowers of spring; then everything you need to know about hostas; Martha takes up bird watching.

title: Martha Gardens
description:
S1 E11 — Martha's Garden Tours of Turkey Hill and Bedford
Martha visits her former home, Turkey Hill, where everything began for Martha in the 1970s; then back to her Bedford farm for a garden club tour - a peek inside Martha's gardens past and present.

title: Martha Cooks
description:
S3 E9 — Authentic Greek Cuisine
Martha and Chef Costas Spiliadis of Estiatorio Milos make Taramasalata and salad; they build an eggplant and zucchini tower with tzatziki; then, they salt-bake a fish served with yogurt.

title: Martha Cooks
description:
S4 E4 — Chef David Burke's Modern Classics
Chef David Burke brings his modern classic dishes to Martha's kitchen; a bacon clothesline, calamari noodles, miso chicken with ginger and vegetables, and key lime pie are on the menu.

title: Martha Cooks
description:
S4 E6 — Sensational Summer Salads
Martha and Salad Freak author Jess Dameck reveal the art of constructing the perfect salad; Martha and Sarah Carey share a new twist on the classic Caesar salad and create a roasted beet salad.

title: Martha Cooks
description:
S4 E7 — Martha Throws a Clam Bake
Martha heads to her local seafood market, Mt. Kisco Seafood, to pick up the perfect ingredients for a clam bake; broiled salmon and delicious creamed spinach.

title: Martha Cooks
description:
S4 E8 — Rustic Italian Cuisine
Martha visits Il Buco Alimentari with chef Justin Smillie and fries artichokes to crispy perfection; they construct a salad with anchovy crumbs followed by spaghetti bottarga and charred duck.

title: Martha Cooks
description:
S4 E9 — Exploring Korean Cuisine
Martha dines at the Korean restaurant NARO and begins her culinary journey with two Korean cocktails; Martha and executive chef Nate Kuester make reimagined versions of traditional Korean cuisine.

title: Martha Cooks
description:
S4 E10 — Martha's Favorite Brunch
Martha prepares a brunch menu with whitefish salad from Acme Smoked Fish Corp and crafts a cocktail featuring two brunch staples; Martha makes her favorite frittata dish and bakes a rhubarb crisp.

title: Martha Stewart Living
description:
S9 E50 — Halloween Makeup
Makeup artists transform Martha into a black widow spider woman and her nephew into a vampire; a spiced grape juice witch's brew; a Halloween house of horror; creepy decorations.

title: Martha Stewart Living
description:
S9 E51 — Saving Heirloom Seeds
Preserving seeds; chef Todd English prepares pumpkin souffle; harvesting pumpkins; pet expert Marc Morrone; fall arrangement; spider treat boxes.

title: Martha Stewart Living
description:
S9 E52 — Bride of Frankenstein
Halloween costumes; artworks by Damien Hirst; Halloween tray liners; Monte Cristo sandwich; creamy tomato soup.

title: Martha Stewart Living
description:
S2 E6 — Halloween Pumpkins; Cookies; Costumes; Decorating
Carving pumpkins; Halloween cookies; costumes; face painting; decorating holiday door; trick or treaters at Turkey Hill.

title: Martha Stewart's Cooking School
description:
S4 E13 — Lamb
Butterflied, rolled and roasted leg of lamb; lamb tagine with spiced butternut squash and prunes; yogurt-marinated lamb kebabs; seared loin lamb chops served with mint jelly and fried fingerling potatoes.
